name: ua_oblast_expl_base_v1
target_doc: explosion day D (Kyiv calendar day) in the oblast: >= 1 monitoring-channel report of explosions naming the oblast (src/explosions.py, explosion_daily). Known negative: no report while the monitor feed was alive (>= 30 posts that day); occupied oblasts (Luhansk, Crimea) have no negatives. Otherwise unknown
features_doc: region indicators, region base rate shrunk toward the all-oblast rate (shrink = pseudo-days), own target at D-2 and its 7-day mean; base/y2/y2_m7 from ob_expl itself (known the same day), plus acled_l / acled_m8 (as v3)
